verdict.rationale: React's own docs cover several pieces of building at scale. Encapsulated, composable components support maintainable structure. TypeScript typing for props and eslint-plugin-react-hooks rules catch bugs early. For speed, React Compiler memoizes automatically at build time and can be adopted incrementally, React Developer Tools help find performance problems, and streaming server rendering is supported. One community comment praises React's efficient change management; another criticism of concurrent-mode complexity is opinion, not a concrete failure. Missing for 10: explicit evidence about scaling to large teams and codebases, and independent benchmarks or hands-on reports of large apps staying fast over time.
